title: A toy model for the quark pole mass
summary: We study the pole mass for a heavy quark probe in the Gross--Neveu model, at the first non-trivial order in the $1/N$ expansion. We show that this mass suffers from a perturbative renormalon ambiguity structurally similar to the one in QCD. The exact large $N$ solution leads however to an explicit expression for the pole mass which can be decoded as a trans-series, and we find that non-perturbative corrections cure the renormalon ambiguity.
